highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 updates the bundled rendering engine to Skia m154 while carrying forward the 4.153 release-line improvements.
highlights_body: It includes Graphite GPU bindings, asynchronous pixel readback, native packaging improvements, and fixes for resource lifetime and allocation overhead.

breaking.title: Linux font fallback may select a different face
breaking.body: Skia now tries FcFontMatch before the previous FcFontSort fallback path, so applications relying on the exact fontconfig fallback may see different glyphs or text metrics. Specify a family and style explicitly, or bundle the typeface, when font selection must be deterministic.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer through the m151 and m152 servicing syncs and m153 to Skia m154, bringing the current upstream engine to the release line.
Adds managed bindings for the Graphite GPU backend on Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn.
SKImage and SKSurface gain backend-neutral RequestReadPixels APIs for asynchronous pixel retrieval.

bullets.lead: Pixel and region sources remain alive during native use
bullets.detail: Fixes use-after-free failures when iterating SKRegion spans and when extracting or transforming SKPixmap subsets.
Fixes raster-image allocation cleanup, HarfBuzz blob conversion cleanup, and replacement uniform-buffer disposal.
Improves common data saving, tag conversion, HarfBuzz shaping, runtime-effect uniform lookup, and handle registration paths.
Restores the Vulkan Silk.NET package, produces Apple native symbol packages, and uses FreeType for Nano Server font support.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Added FreeType-backed font support for Nano Server
contributor_summaries.mmitche: Improved the native Windows build environment setup
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Added Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn

preview_summaries.v4.152.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 introduced the Graphite GPU bindings, asynchronous pixel readback, resource-lifetime fixes, and the Skia m152 engine update.
preview_summaries.v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14: Release Candidate 1 completed native packaging improvements, restored the Vulkan Silk.NET package, and added the m152 servicing sync.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp improves shaping and tag-conversion performance, fixes blob conversion cleanup, and carries the release-line packaging updates.
